application_review: For any actual integer submodule of a real vector space and any actual real subspace, the quotient by their integer intersection has a constructed injective integer linear map into the real quotient. It is torsion-free, and is free when the original integer module is finitely generated.

The original integer quotient map has an actual integer linear right inverse by the proved finite free quotient and projectivity. Its image is an integer direct complement to the actual integer intersection. This construction does not substitute a rational vector-space complement for an integer complement.

For the genuine original central logarithmic lattice and every actual original lower-central layer, actual integer intersection membership is exactly original layer membership of the original vector. The actual integer quotient is free and has an integer direct complement inside the genuine original central lattice. The original finite lattice basis discharges finite generation; no additive lattice of full Log Gamma is assumed.

The integer intersection is literally the preimage of the original real subspace under the actual original integer-submodule inclusion. The quotient embedding is constructed by the real quotient projection and actual integer quotient lift; its kernel is proved zero using actual quotient representatives. No discreteness or rationality premise is needed for this elementary statement.

Torsion-freeness is pulled back along the proved actual injective quotient map from the real quotient as an integer module. Finite generation of the integer quotient is supplied by the actual surjective original quotient map. The standard PID theorem for finitely generated torsion-free integer modules proves freeness, including the zero-dimensional and trivial-quotient cases.

The split uses the actual integer-linear scalar restriction of the original quotient projection, preserving its literal function. This avoids a module-instance diamond between canonical integer scalar structures and inherited quotient scalar structures. No algebraic map is replaced by a freely chosen function; the actual right-inverse identity is proved as an equality of integer linear maps.

For the right-inverse image Q, actual quotient evaluation proves intersection disjointness. Every original integer vector x is explicitly decomposed as x-s(pi(x)) plus s(pi(x)), with the first term in the actual integer intersection. These prove IsCompl over Z, not over Q or R.

The native application uses the genuine original center logarithmic lattice, whose additive lattice status was previously proved using the actual original commuting exponential laws. The layer intersection is the comap of the actual original real Lie lower-central layer through the actual center inclusion. The chosen original integer lattice basis proves Module.Finite Z L; no formal full Log Gamma lattice is introduced.

Each layer receives an integer complement, but their choices are not claimed compatible. No simultaneous central flag basis, full ordered basis adaptation, paper horizontal size identification, quantitative equidistribution input, full StrongConjecture, unavoidable obstruction, independent kernel replay, public repository, PR or prize submission is asserted.

All retained registered proof sources and axiom sets are checked unchanged. Focused autoImplicit=false checks, full build, standard-only selected axiom reports and all six pinned primary sections are author-side verification.

StrongConjecture remains unproved; no unavoidable obstruction is established. The corrected real-box geometric and coefficient transfer, actual rational connected stretched filtration, native weighted Picard/BCH group difference polynomiality and uniform ordinary difference degree are proved. Fixed finite nonzero horizontal character candidates, actual normalized rational directions and positive lattice periods are constructed from a fixed operator norm budget. The real-box transfer is still conditional on equal-cube exact binomial obstruction existence and its modular coefficient bounds. The actual rational real basis adapted to the commutator layer and the conversion from identified Euclidean horizontal integer coordinates to the fixed functional norm budget are now proved. This split basis is not yet a lattice-coordinate Malcev basis adapted to the whole filtration; integrality of its complement coordinates is not asserted. Prove the actual equal-side quantitative Leibman input, including character existence and uniform coefficient bounds, and finish the required Malcev basis and filtration adaptation. Global ordered exponential coordinates of the correct dimension, with bijectivity and exact original Gamma/integer-coordinate correspondence, are now proved by actual center induction. The chosen original ordered vector family is now proved linearly independent and upgraded to an actual real basis and an identical-column rational basis of the original logarithmic span, with rational original bracket structure constants and actual unique integral functional evaluations. A strengthened original center induction now constructs a fixed original ordered lattice real basis with a genuine global smooth two-sided inverse and packages its ordered exponential map as an actual Diffeomorph. That same smooth basis has an identical-column rational basis of the original logarithmic span and rational original adjoint differential structure constants. Integer quotients of the genuine original central logarithmic lattice by each original lower-central-layer intersection are now proved free with actual integer complements. This provides the arithmetic splitting for central flag adaptation. A simultaneously adapted integer basis for the whole central flag, its smooth ordered center extension and full prescribed filtration adaptation of the original ordered lattice basis remain unproved. This strengthened smooth basis is chosen separately from the earlier basis-only choice; their literal equality is not asserted. For the same smooth original lattice-coordinate basis, exact character linear evaluation, the two-way Gamma-integrality/integer-evaluation criterion, unique integer differential representation, finite rational bracket equations and a direct bounded-integer horizontal grid are now proved. Every character in this direct grid has a normalized rational direction with an explicitly positive original lattice period at most the fixed integer grid budget. The Euclidean size here is the full integer vector in that smooth basis; it is still not identified with the paper filtration-adapted horizontal coefficient norm. No analytic character existence or modular binomial coefficient bound is discharged. No quantitative equidistribution theorem is asserted by the finite grid construction. Connect the actual finite candidate obstruction to normalized descent and finish dimension induction with actual length restriction, cofinal scales and the zero-dimensional base. Finite density extraction and the full uniform rough-step comparison remain open. Conditional face laws, buffered short-bin geometry, prior-event positivity, extra-conditioning posterior control, quantitative smooth-observable bounds, face invariance and positive-probability Alignment remain open. HasNativePeriodicIntervalInverse and HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remain explicit unproved existence inputs; final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction remains open. No independent kernel replay, external review, public contribution or prize submission is claimed.
